item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses one `dspy.ChatAdapter()` and `adapter.format(QA, [], {\"question\": \"What is 2 + 2?\"})` to precompute messages."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `DummyLM([{\"answer\": \"4\"}], adapter=adapter)` so the example runs offline and returns a parsed result."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Instantiates `dspy.Predict(QA)` and calls it with the same concrete question."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Reads `actual_messages` from `lm.history[-1][\"messages\"]`, i.e. the real recorded LM request."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `actual_messages == expected_messages`, directly checking exact prompt equivalence."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Prints both message lists and asserts `result.answer == \"4\"`, confirming successful prediction."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
